overviewHtml:
Some problem signatures fire hundreds of times because nobody added up what they cost. This workflow weighs 30 days of chronic problems and tells you what to do about each one.

What you get

  • Two DQL queries on dt.davis.problems: top signatures by downtime and week-over-week trend
  • FIX, TUNE or SUPPRESS classification for every signature
  • Separation of flapping from sustained impact
  • The evidence that would confirm the cause before you act
  • Recommendations delivered by email every week
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace tenant with Davis problems being generated (any monitored environment)
  • Apps: dynatrace.automations (Workflows), dynatrace.davis.workflow.actions (Agentic AI prompt action), dynatrace.email
  • An email connection configured for the dynatrace.email:send-email action
setupHtml:
1. Download chronic-problem-pattern-advisor.workflow-template.yaml.
  2. In your Dynatrace environment, open Workflows → Create workflow → Upload YAML (or the ... menu → Import) and select the file.
  3. Open the mail_report task and set the actual to recipients (the template ships with empty to/cc/bcc).
  4. Review the schedule (0 7 * * 1, Mondays 07:00 Europe/Vienna) and adjust the cron/timezone if needed.
  5. Enable the workflow.
getStartedHtml:
You need an email connection.

  1. Import the workflow template into Workflows
  2. Set the email recipients
  3. Check the schedule and enable the workflow
